narr: The remnants of Debby tracked through the area Thursday night into Friday, August 8th into August 9th. Tropical moisture combined with lift from the remnants to cause heavy rain across much of Virginia. The heavy rain led to several instances of flash flooding and flooding.
ev: Shepherds Mills road was closed due to water flowing across the road.
Howellsville Road was closed due to high water in multiple spots.
The road was closed due to flooding near Rockfish Road and Howardsville Turnpike.
Plank Road was closed due to flooding from Craigs Store Road and Stillhouse Creek Road.
Glade Road was closed due to flooding from Aerial Drive to Piney Mountain Place.

County Emergency Management reported three cars stuck in flood waters near the bridge that goes over South River at Octonia Road. One motorist had to be rescued after their car got swept into the South River.

The water level at Strathmeade Springs rapidly rose above flood stage. At flood stage, Woodburn Road is covered by about six inches of flowing water at its lowest point. The water fell below flood stage at 8:25 AM EST.
